data.body: AC amendment: Explicitly enumerate BOTH paths in record-review.sh: (1) MAIN FLOW PATH — remove the embedded Python blocks that read scores (~lines 262-510) and replace with severity-only STATUS determination. Remove both the score-reading validator AND the out-of-diff score-reset block (~lines 465-510). (2) ATTEST PATH (~lines 140-205) — remove SOURCE_SCORE extraction, remove 'if [[ -z SOURCE_SCORE ]]' check, remove 'score=SOURCE_SCORE' from the cat heredoc, update the echo message. (3) HEADER COMMENTS — update the header docblock to remove 'scores: object with hygiene...' and 'Line 4: score=...' lines. Add harvest-attestation-format.md contract doc to the file impact list.
